subject_executed: Two-arm paired CBP experiment (D=Adam-v_t utility vs RANDOM=random-reset control), SmallConvNetGN GroupNorm ConvNet, real CIFAR-100 /opt/datasets, 4 tasks x 5 classes class-incremental, 1000 steps/task, reset_every=100 steps, reset_frac=0.10, Adam lr=1e-3, 8 seeds {0..7} fully paired (same task split per seed), primary metric = mean accuracy tasks 2-4
notes: YES: v_t's ranking carries real information beyond 'any reset helps equally'. D (Adam-v_t CBP) beats RANDOM (random-reset same cadence+fraction) by +4.33pp mean (CI=[0.275,8.391]pp, one-sided paired t-test p=0.0198, n=8 seeds). 6 of 8 per-seed diffs are positive. Effect is statistically significant at p<0.05. Conclusion: the utility ranking from Adam's exp_avg_sq (v_t) is the operative factor, not merely the act of periodically resetting neurons.
